question: Does the corrected finite residual-to-consumer grammar select exactly one complete, source-compatible Duskblade-only private-state contract without reopening an immutable closed family?
hypothesis: Positive Ember overflow is the sole unrepresented, deterministic, naturally costly Dusk-specific residual, and exact Heavy Blow is the unique minimum consumer because its single hit gives stronger direct causal attribution than the two other legal reward-only plain Attacks.
claimBoundary: Exact-source residual and consumer enumeration, closure non-aliasing, twelve-field completeness and zero-row selection only. No identity, behaviour, capacity, support, causal endpoint, complementarity, package, detector, product, protected-seed, #421 acceptance or P9 claim.

sourceAssertions.contains: var next: int = clampi(cb.embers + n, 0, cb.ember_cap)
var preview_v: Variant = game.rules.preview_play(game.cb, card, target, game.run)

closureAliases: fixed encounter context and free start grant

residualCandidates.sourceBoundary: positive gain_embers request truncated by ember_cap

consumerGrammar.pool: normal common, uncommon and rare cardPools
selectionVector: one private mark plus combat and preview surfaces
one plus authored hit count as direct experiment cost

selectedContract.producer: For mechanism-on Duskblade only, a positive gain_embers request with lost = requested gain - realised positive delta greater than zero; set once per player turn regardless of larger loss.
selectedContract.mediatorState: One non-stacking combat-only player-private mark carrying exactly one lost Ember; legal levels are 0 and 1.
selectedContract.consumer: A later exact heavyBlow play against its ordinary selected living enemy in the same player turn.
selectedContract.payoffOperation: Consume the mark and add exactly 3 damage to Heavy Blow's single ordinary hit; legal factor levels are 0 off and 3 on, derived from current Flare 9 divided by cost 3.
selectedContract.lifecycleExpiry: Set after realised overflow; consume on exact Heavy Blow; otherwise clear at player end turn, victory, loss or combat disposal. Never cross a turn.
selectedContract.naturalCost: Reach the Ember cap, forfeit at least one positive Ember gain, acquire and draw Heavy Blow, pay its unchanged cost 2 and play it after the overflow.
selectedContract.duskBoundary: Duskblade aspect index 0 only. Ashwarden, absent factor and factor off are exact current-main null paths.
selectedContract.scorelineFactor: Fixed absent and off. Chisel, Executioner, enemy marks and Scoreline payoff remain closed and unchanged.
selectedContract.afterimageFactor: Fixed absent and off. Defend, Guarded Strike, player Ward marks and Afterimage payoff remain closed and unchanged.
selectedContract.interferenceRule: Current Ember reserve, cap, Art, Kindle, Shatter, kill, card effects, costs, rarities, pools, RNG and policy identities remain unchanged. No joint Scoreline or Afterimage cell before a later preregistered interference decision.
selectedContract.nullPath: Omitted/off, non-positive gain, uncapped gain, absent mark, non-Heavy-Blow play, expired mark and Ashwarden must preserve path, RNG, events, comparator and result exactly after research-only telemetry removal.
selectedContract.policyExposure: Use frozen existing card and enemy-target choice plus exact previewed loss first. At most one bounded timing control may be considered only after direct evidence proves that exact missing timing decision is the bottleneck.

decisionRules.success: Exactly one residual is legal, exact content yields the frozen consumer set, one consumer has a unique best selection vector, the complete twelve-field contract matches, every identity passes, the ledger is byte-identical and execution completes within 30 seconds.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply boundary 1: freeze only positive-ember-overflow to Heavy Blow for a separately preregistered research-only source/interface, call-cardinality, comparator, exact-null and direct A/B/AB preflight. Add no capacity row, protected seed, product mutation, ML, RL or optimiser.
decisionRules.futility: No legal residual or consumer remains under the corrected finite grammar.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply boundary 2: close the corrected private-state causal grammar at zero rows. Preserve every archive and only then reassess the all-four-classes human-authority trigger; do not create a successor or weaken acceptance.
decisionRules.inconclusive: More than one legal residual or top-ranked consumer remains tied before canonical SHA, or exact source/evidence identity is unavailable at the frozen cap.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply boundary 3: record the exact tie or unavailable identity at the zero-row cap. Do not select by support, outcome, aesthetics, rerun, method or product mutation.
